description: Propagation Modeling Website (PMW) is provided by NTIA Institute for Telecommunication Sciences. NTIA's Propagation Modeling Website supports RF analyses from 10 kHz to 20 GHz using several propagation models. Users can analyse individual transmitters or upload Excel batch specifications, then obtain TIFF, KMZ and shapefile outputs and population-coverage reports. Geographic context: global (software applicability). Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here.
